RaggieSoft Document Studio • Deterministic ISO 14289-1 PDF/UA-1 Compiler

Compile Verified Tagged PDF/UA-1 Handbooks & Forms from Plain Text.

Municipalities, universities, hospitals, and federal contractors lose thousands of engineering hours manually repairing broken tag trees whenever a Word or desktop-publishing document is re-exported to PDF. RaggieSoft Document Studio compiles Git-diffable .rsdp manifests and Markdown directly into machine-verified Tagged PDF/UA-1 documents and accessible HTML5 forms—failing the build if table scopes, reading order, bookmarks, or alt text are missing.

Pair with Accessibility Studio v1.0 → Back to 8-Tool Suite Overview
Zero Manual Tag-Tree Repair on Every Revision

Core Architectural Pillars of Document Studio

1. Authentic Structure Tree Generation (<Document>, <H1>..<H6>, <Table>)

Emits genuine PDF/UA-1 structure trees, /Lang catalogs, embedded subset fonts, and /Scope table headers automatically on every build.

2. Dual Output: Print-Ready Tagged PDF + Responsive WCAG 2.2 AA HTML5

Publish official board packets, SOPs, and training completion certificates simultaneously as accessible web pages and archival tagged PDFs.

3. Compile-Time Matterhorn & Section 508 Gate

Blocks untagged figures, skipped heading hierarchies, unlabeled form fields, and low-contrast callouts in CI/CD before distribution.

4. Deterministic Reproducible Builds

Plain-text .rsdp + Markdown diffs cleanly in Git pull requests so legal, HR, and engineering teams can review exact policy wording changes.
